title: Honest feedback-model documentation
story: As a reader, I want the feedback model described honestly so I don't over-trust it.
description: State plainly, in UI and README, how the feedback model works and what it is not.
acceptance_criteria: README and UI describe feedback as annual, lagged and linearly ramped
Documentation states it is not cumulative capital-stock modelling
